answer: A sack that leaks loses the flour, so the packer fills every sack with bran and watches the seams. Millet buckwheat oven sweeper shelling bond governs the filling: a bond buckwheat oven sweepers lodge after oven mouth checks. The marble is the first seam watched, the ivory the last before the sack is tipped out, and the lagoon is the tipping, the bran running over the loft boards. Faking the fill takes 101 false seams and 101 false tippings.
